name: calculate_cap_rate
description: Calculate capitalization rate and related investment metrics: cap rate, gross rent multiplier, price per unit, operating expense ratio, and comparison to market average cap rates.

purchase_price.description: Property purchase price or current market value in dollars

annual_noi.description: Annual Net Operating Income in dollars (gross income minus operating expenses)

name: analyze_rental_income
description: Analyze rental income potential for a property: estimated rent, vacancy rate, itemized operating expenses, NOI, cash flow after mortgage, and rent comparables.

property_type.description: Type of property (One of: single_family, condo, townhouse, multi_family, duplex)

name: calculate_roi
description: Calculate comprehensive ROI for a property: cash-on-cash return, cap rate, mortgage amortization (30-year), equity buildup, tax benefits (27.5-year depreciation), and 5-year projection.

purchase_price.description: Total property purchase price in dollars

interest_rate.description: Annual mortgage interest rate percentage, e.g. 6.5 for 6.5%

rental_income.description: Expected annual gross rental income in dollars

expenses.description: Expected annual operating expenses in dollars

name: get_investment_comparison
description: Compare multiple investment properties side by side, ranked by total estimated return: cap rate, cash-on-cash return, NOI, cash flow, price-to-rent ratio, and risk level.

properties.description: JSON array of properties to compare, e.g. '[{"address": "123 Main St", "price": 500000}]'
